name: Video Thumbnail Concurrency Tuning
changes: Raises only the high-connection-provider Video thumbnail scheduler ceiling from four to six for providers with 48 or more configured connections.
Keeps the overall adaptive preview concurrency and download-reserve budget authoritative, so Video work remains automatically constrained when downloads are active.
Preserves schema-6 Video HTTP/server/transport/BODY/queue telemetry so production diagnostics can directly measure whether six slots reduce visible queueing without worsening provider latency.
Preserves the five-request Image HTTP gate, provider allocation, 24 MB Video sample limit, 800-header strategy, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Discover, Smart Import, and Automation behavior.
regression_guards: Providers with 48+ connections may use at most six Video thumbnail tasks; lower tiers remain 1/2/3 and the result is still bounded by state.thumbConcurrency.
No Video localhost HTTP admission gate is added and schema-6 request-paired Video telemetry remains intact.
The Image thumbnail HTTP admission limit remains five and Image scheduler/provider behavior is otherwise unchanged.
SABnzbd 5.1.2, terminal-history schema 3, 800/800/1000 browsing headers, resolver batching, Discover, Smart Import, and Automation remain unchanged.
